empty_prediction_rule: if no voxel exceeds p = 0.5 the flag cannot assess the structure; report 'no tumour found, which is not the same as no tumour'. In the training data 0 of the 75 cases had an empty prediction, so this rule was not exercised.
trained_on: 75 UID-route HCC-TACE-Seg cases with a non-empty prediction (+0 empty); cross-validated AUROC 0.925
label: tumour Dice < 0.7
